comment: He lectures a lot but he's not boring at all. It's actually not bad to sit and listen to him talk for an hour and 15 minutes. I didn't dread it and I learned a ton.
Great guy even better teacher. Really knows his stuff and allows students to choose test formats.
I took his American Government class online, over the summer, and found it to be super easy! He grades the papers very leniently. The Exams and quizzes (all multiple choice) are of medium difficulty.
Dr. Ritter is the absolute man.  I have never met a nicer guy, and he is very accomodating for all students.

Ritter is a great guy. The class is easy. All classes are taught from powerpoint which can be boring. This isn't going to make you want to be a Poli Sci major but it won't deter you either. He lets the class choose the test format as well. Overall Recommended.
great professor!  extremely nice and very fair, and willing to help if you seek him out.  a great guy.

Ritter is a purely lecture class. He teaches from a powerpoint for the most part. The class was incredibly easy and a review of AP Govt. Students choose the format of the tests and the number of questions on the test. Assigns a few papers. He has an attendance sheet and occasionally will walk around the room. Laptops are allowed.

Prof. Ritter is a great guy. He is great at teaching and he let's students decide what kind of test they want. I would recommend his class. You learn a lot and if you pay attention and work hard, will get a good grade.

Ritter is a really good guy, but not terribly engaging.  He'll help you out if you ask him, and he's really accommodating.  Class will consist of powerpoints and reading slides.  Reading the text is hardly necessary.  He grades papers easily, and usually lets students decide the format of the tests (mult choice or short answer, for example)

very boring professor.  lectures with powerpoints all class, every class.  his monotone voice makes it impossible to stay awake and pay attention.  however, he is not too hard of a grader on papers, and tests and quizzes are usually multiple choice.
Great professor, very fair in grading.
